'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Josh Mack LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Remaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
